notes.title: Minor Fixes
notes.notes:
Minor bugfixes/changes:
[b]* [Improvement][/b] The Dpad wanted to be used for movement on controllers. Who am I to get in the way?
[b]* [Improvement][/b] Tweak Joystick movement leniency for controllers. Turns out Joysticks like to wiggle.
[b]* [Fix][/b] Unintended "Breaking the ice barrier" achievement unlock. The irony that a "breaking" achievement was broken is not lost on me.
[b]* [Fix][/b] Can't warp in some cases. Well, one case that I know of, there might be more might be less...
[b]* [Fix][/b] Controller selection on main menu was a tad spotty. I do list "partial" controller support, but this was a bit too partial.

[b]* [Known bug][/b] Maximising the window will cause the end of level screen to not show "Level completed" but all the other UI elements appear fine. I have no idea why this happens, try to just resize the window rather than maximising? This one is... [i]suspicious[/i]. Alternatively, press "[b]P[/b]" to change inbetween two common resolutions or "[b]Alt-Enter[/b]" to enter fullscreen.

[i][b]Spaceroaddddddssssss!!!! Woo! Yeah! Best game ever just got even better wooo![/b][/i]
